steps.instruction: Leave NGENUITY Legacy closed, including its tray icon. Do not launch it, change settings, save or reconnect the mouse. This is the no-op baseline.
When Capturing appears, launch NGENUITY Legacy once and leave it open. Do not change settings, click Save to mouse, or accept any firmware update.
When Capturing appears, close NGENUITY Legacy from its tray icon. Do not change settings, click Save to mouse, or reconnect the mouse. Leave the app closed after this capture.
